blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO, Zambales — The ports of Subic and San Diego in California, are set to establish a “sister-port” partnership on Friday (Oct. 16, Philippine time) in San Diego to promote trade, cruise tourism and environmentally sustainable port operations. The agreement will provide a framework for cooperation in commercial cargo development, logistics, cruise operations and green port technologies, according to the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA).
